WLIIA Functions

Function to perform spectral masking.

WLIIA.build_line_dict_ESPRESSO(df, spectral_type, min_intensity=0, top_n=None) → dict

Builds a dictionary of ESPRESSO lines for a given spectral type.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – The input DataFrame containing the ESPRESSO line data.

  • spectral_type (str) – The spectral type for which to build the line dictionary.

  • min_intensity (float, optional) – The minimum intensity threshold for including lines (default is 0).

  • top_n (int, optional) – The maximum number of lines to include (default is None, meaning all lines).

Returns:

A dictionary containing the ESPRESSO lines for the specified spectral type.

Return type:

dict

WLIIA.clean_spectrum(df, plot=False) → DataFrame

Cleans the spectrum DataFrame by removing rows with NaN values and ensuring the data types are correct.

Parameters:

df (pd.DataFrame) – The input DataFrame containing the spectrum data.

Returns:

A cleaned DataFrame with no NaN values and correct data types.

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

WLIIA.match_known_lines(wavelengths, flux, line_dict, tolerance=0.01, prominence=0.2, region=None) → list

Match observed spectrum lines to known lines from a line dictionary.

Parameters:

  • wavelengths (array-like) – The observed wavelengths.

  • flux (array-like) – The observed flux values.

  • line_dict (dict) – A dictionary of known lines.

  • tolerance (float, optional) – The maximum allowed difference between observed and known lines (default is 0.01).

  • prominence (float, optional) – The minimum prominence of peaks to consider (default is 0.2).

  • region (tuple, optional) – A tuple specifying the wavelength range to consider (default is None, meaning all wavelengths).

Returns:

A list of matched lines.

Return type:

list

WLIIA.read_spectrum(file_name) → DataFrame

Loads a spectrum from a .spectrum or .fits file and returns it as a pandas DataFrame with columns ‘Wavelength’ and ‘Spectrum’. Returns a DataFrame with the spectrum data or a value error if the file format is unsupported.

Parameters:

file_name (str) – The path to the spectrum file. It can be either a .spectrum or .fits file.

Returns:

A DataFrame containing the spectrum data with columns ‘Wavelength’ and ‘Spectrum’.

Return type:

pd.DataFrame
